items.description: with two stock records filed for different SKUs, opening the stock-by-location screen lists one row per filed record showing its sku, location, and quantity (full read path against the branch DB)
the stock-list boundary handler delegates entirely to StockService/StockRepository and never opens a DB session directly (layering contract for the read path)
the stock-list API boundary returns a JSON array of stock records, not server-rendered HTML, for the browse table (SPA JSON boundary contract)
